entry.description: A color palette for the instruments documented in the music you listen to.
entry.heroAlt: Historical Chladni experiment in pink and black duotone
entry.heroExplanation: In Chladni's experiment, a vibrating plate makes grains collect in the areas that vibrate least, forming patterns. A way to make sound visible.
entry.title: Discover what <emphasis>your listening is made of.</emphasis>
